reviews.title: This app went from my joy to my anger
reviews.text: Until recently, I had been playing this game addictively for years. As an Autistic person with ADHD, it was the perfect game to keep my hands and brain engaged while streaming movies or chilling out at the end of the day. However, a couple of weeks ago, the game board started glitching out; the touch-responsiveness just wasn’t there anymore. There’s nothing more frustrating than having the blocks drop randomly! I followed the developer’s recommendation of reaching out through the in-app help chat, but no one ever replied. This is an app-based glitch, for sure. Playing the original Wood Block puzzle isn’t nearly as satisfying! Hurry up and fix this thing!!

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text:
I used to play all the time, now it is too buggy, so it becomes frustrating instead of fun. 
Issues- ads are much longer now and most no longer have an X to close them, so you can’t get back to your game. You’re caught in an endless loop of watching the ad and being sent to the App Store. Many ads just go to black screen and you have to restart your phone to get the App to work again. 
I agree with others on the “fake” addition of coins. You watch the ads but don’t really get the coins. 
Bottom line, this app went from 5 to 2 stars and I no longer play it.

reviews.title: Agreed  sometimes frustrating
reviews.text:
I really enjoy playing this game… I enjoy the challenge. But as others have commented, the game will freeze for what appears to be no apparent reason and then you have to close it out and reopen the game… And wait for which I think is too long of a time and sometimes the same game will be there.  It takes a tremendous amount of your time with the ads and the freezing. If I played games more often I definitely would not keep this as one of my games; I’m already looking for similar games because of those issues even though I really enjoy the game itself.  
Apparently, they don’t take much notice of the negative comments because some of them are over a year old and the same issues are still occurring.
